batches.title: Clear Library and collection identity
acceptance_criteria: Liked, playlist membership, recent history, derived creator groups and offline files have distinct truthful labels/counts, including a history-only listener.
Create, rename, pin/folder, filter and sort a real playlist through the screen; stable order and saved membership survive return/restart.
Select visible and filtered-hidden valid rows, remove/reorder and Undo; bounded atomic edits preserve unrelated collections and stale-local guards.
Export/import the supported playlist document through the system picker, cancel, malformed input and name conflict; preview and explicit confirmation preserve original data.

batches.title: Player artwork and metadata finish
acceptance_criteria: Use legitimate best-available source art with correctly sized requests and cache/fallback behavior; missing or low-resolution art never becomes a fake verified album cover.
Keep title/creator, Save, transport and seek stable at 320/360/412dp and large type; artwork scrolling/swipes cannot obscure or trigger the wrong transport.
Distinguish current-song buffering, paused, playing and failure states; full player, mini-player and notification refer to the same selected identity.
Seek by touch and accessibility during track change/reconnect; position confirmation is tied to the reviewed track and required queue/lyrics paths remain understandable.

batches.title: Queue and transport acceptance
acceptance_criteria: From a real multi-item queue, add Play Next, reorder/remove/Undo and clear explicitly; current song and manual-next priority remain correct.

Exercise shuffle Previous/Next through visited history, repeat one/all and natural end; queue labels match the authoritative service and no unrelated song is appended after a single-song search selection.
Background, process-recreate and reconnect around a queue edit; accepted commands and persisted selection remain coherent without stale UI overwrites.
Test notification, headset/Bluetooth and call/audio-focus transports on declared devices; collect timing and wrong-track/error evidence.

batches.title: Offline import and readiness journey
acceptance_criteria: An empty listener can import an owned supported file through the system picker, see verification and reach one truthful Ready item in the unified Library.
Disable connectivity, stop/reopen the validation app and play/seek/skip an eligible imported/downloaded file; record actual offline completion.
Corrupt/remove/revoke access or simulate storage failure; show repair/reimport/retry only where valid and never label an unreadable index as mass file deletion.
Per-source capabilities explain import, download, stream-only and unsupported cases before action; user consent alone never fabricates provider capability or rights.

batches.title: Resumable recoverable transfers
source_areas: offline transfer stores and integrity policies
acceptance_criteria: For an explicitly eligible controlled server, pause/restart retains bounded source-bound partial bytes and resumes a validated range instead of starting over.
Reject wrong ETag/Last-Modified/content identity, invalid 206/Content-Range, expiry and mixed bytes; safe full restart is explicit when resumption is unsupported.
With a stable job ID, progress/readiness and retained bytes remain truthful through navigation, process death, network drop, cancellation and low storage.
Completed audio passes real integrity/readback and offline playback; partial/cancelled/corrupt data never appears Ready, and abandoned partial files are cleaned by a tested policy.

batches.title: Useful user-owned lyrics
acceptance_criteria: A listener imports an owned UTF-8 LRC through a guided preview and explicit track binding; stable source identity prevents lyrics attaching to a different recording.
Implement the declared supported online-reference/local-audio lyric scope with explicit unavailable states; no unapproved scrape/provider catalog or automatic translation claim.
English/Bangla timed lines, repeated cues, offsets, manual scroll/follow, seek and rotation work; preserve strict parsing, lossless rejection and export.
TalkBack and large-font lyric reading, selected-line contrast and measured seek/follow timing pass on the actual player without wrong-track updates.

batches.title: Sound Studio active and draft clarity
acceptance_criteria: Simple Off/preset controls and an explicit advanced draft view clearly distinguish current applied state, preview and unapplied edits; Apply stays reachable.
Change session/control ownership or same-count frequency/range/preset identity; stale commands reject before writes and current readback determines active state.
Perform recorded permitted speaker/headphone/Bluetooth A/B checks with stable volume; separate audible evidence from framework gain readback.
Crossfade/gapless, normalization and speed remain truthful for supported local routes; large-text/TalkBack band changes retain labels, units and independent controls.

batches.title: Complete optional recovery journey
acceptance_criteria: With a disposable account/archive, actually upload/read back, preview and restore/merge; compare contents and prove no silent overwrite of the listener library.
Account switch/reconnect, newer access proof, changed consent and local edits fence stale work even when timestamps coincide; cancellation preserves prior proof appropriately.
Revoke access or inject transient network/storage failure; account state, old backup receipt, progress/retry and saved disconnect remain truthful.
A compact account flow offers one contextual primary action, useful busy phases and reachable recovery/help; metadata backup and audio-file scope are explicit.

batches.title: Measured Android performance
acceptance_criteria: Measure reference-device cold fully drawn/warm resume and 10k input-to-results p50/p95 including debounce; compare matched before/after and the declared budgets.
Measure 100 local Next actions to audible start separately from network/cold decode and natural transitions; preserve selected-song/queue correctness.
Capture Perfetto/frame, allocation/GC and retained-memory evidence for startup, scroll, rapid typing and route cycles; prioritize actual main-thread IO/index hotspots.
Run matched-power playback/battery and at least 60-minute integration soak; baseline profiles or caching have measured benefit without stale data or unbounded retained memory.

batches.title: Accessibility and Bangla English
acceptance_criteria: Complete core tasks with TalkBack/Switch Access; order, headings, state announcements and independent row/remove/slider actions are correct.
At 1x/2x/3x type and all themes, required text/actions remain readable/reachable with measured contrast and 48dp independent targets.
Move primary-flow strings/plurals/status units into resources; English/Bangla UI, Bangla combining marks, mixed-script titles and locale dates/numbers render correctly.
Reduced motion removes unnecessary transitions while preserving static loading/playing feedback; no meaning relies solely on color, animation or a gesture.

batches.title: Adaptive layouts and input
acceptance_criteria: Inspect 320/360/412dp, landscape, tablet and split-screen profiles with realistic long titles; no required control clips or becomes unreachable.
Open keyboard/system picker and rotate during search/import/queue/lyrics; insets and restored destination/state remain correct.
Use navigation/gesture Back, hardware keyboard focus and external input; independent actions and focus order remain predictable.
Default and compact density use available space intentionally; large-type/tablet reflow adapts structure rather than shrinking labels to fit.

batches.title: First run failures and trust
acceptance_criteria: A new guest can understand local/import/public-reference scope and start a supported listening task without compulsory Google sign-in or redundant empty cards.
For each primary action, test empty/loading/disabled/unsupported/offline/error/success states with one understandable next step and retained user work.
Help/Advanced retains diagnostics, export and recovery tools while removing storage-migration terminology from everyday preference rows.
Review actual data flows, permissions, support export redaction, dependencies/history and applicable source/provider/release approvals; unresolved issues remain explicit release blockers.

batches.title: Finish external controls and sharing
acceptance_criteria: Verify existing notification/widget and supported car/headset surfaces reflect selected track and route, and transport works after reconnect/restart.
Share/import/export the declared playlist format with preview, cap/omission notice, name conflict, cancellation and malformed-input safety.
Return from an external provider/share/picker to the intended NightWave route with the same queue and playback state.
Document verified album/artist catalogs, Connect-like handoff and collaborative/social/AI services as separate evaluated scope; add no nonfunctional controls or invented service claims.

batches.title: Cross-device certification and re-rating
source_areas: release tooling and final artifact evidence
acceptance_criteria: Execute the original 139 cases and new 80 cases against the exact final source/APK on both declared device classes; resolve every critical/high-severity failure.
Run the preregistered eight-listener task study, report every outcome and re-rate the frozen weighted rubric; 9.5 requires no core area below 9 and no unknown critical gate.
Complete two-hour mixed foreground/background playback/route tests plus real restoration/offline and matched performance/battery evidence; retain raw receipts and failures.

Build/sign/attest the final artifact, verify installed update continuity and all applicable privacy/source/distribution approvals; record release GO or specific NO-GO independently of the product score.
